messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: Incident triggered: elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (rule: gateway-5xx-rate). Paging on-call @maria (severity: elevated)
maria (oncall): I'm on it, moving to this thread. Any customer-facing reports yet?
jon: seeing a sharp spike in gateway 502/504s starting ~2026-11-02T13:04:00Z. example corr ids: corr=ff3a1b, corr=db7c22
irina: confirmed alerts from eu-west and us-central at 13:04Z-13:10Z, request rate doubled then errored
devin: logs show upstream retries to model-backend-1 increasing (retry_count=3). Might be retry amplification
sam: quick mitigation idea: apply ingress rate limiting for non-interactive routes and reduce retry policy. Can someone flip a config? :thinking_face:
ops-bot: /run set-rate-limit --route "chat.generate" --rps 50 --scope global (executed by sam)
jon: rate-limit applied, watching 1m windows
maria (oncall): can we paste a couple of raw log lines with correlation ids so SRE/infra can trace?
jon: logs from gateway:
```
[2026-11-02T13:07:12.342Z] req_id=ff3a1b path=/v1/generate client=10.2.3.4 upstream=model-backend-1 status=502 latency=73ms retries=1 trace=trace://abc123
```

irina: another one from us-central:
```
[2026-11-02T13:08:45.128Z] req_id=db7c22 path=/v1/generate upstream=model-backend-1 status=504 retries=3 route=gateway-a conn=reset
```

maria (oncall): initial hypothesis: model-backend-1 experiencing resource exhaustion (mem/cpu) causing 5xx; gateway retries (3x) amplify request volume -> cascade.
devin: +1. Also check if a recent replica deploy or quantized variant rolled out to that backend around 13:00Z
sam: we can disable automatic retries for 5xx on the gateway as a canary. I'll push a canary change to envoy config (no retries for 5xx).
deploy-bot: Canary push started by sam -> gateway-canary-1 (rev: 84f5a2).
jon: canary applied, metrics pipeline shows 5xx rate flattening in canary hosts within 1 minute
maria (oncall): timeline (so far): 13:04 alert -> 13:06 on-call paged -> 13:10 rate-limit applied -> 13:14 retry policy changed (canary) -> 13:18 5xx rate decreasing.
irina: capturing corr ids for RCA: ff3a1b, db7c22, 9e4c11. Saved to incident folder.
maria (oncall): mitigation summary: ingress rate-limit + disable gateway retries for 5xx on canary; both appear to reduce amplifying behavior. No full cluster restart required.
devin: next diagnostic steps: pull heap/GC logs from model-backend-1 replicas, check autoscaler events and pod restarts, inspect kernel logs for OOM kills. Might be memory leak or inefficient batching under concurrent load.
sam: customer impact: a minority of calls returned 502/504 for ~10-15 minutes. Support notified; we'll prepare a status note if customers ask. No persisted data lost. :white_check_mark:
jon: adding links to correlated traces/logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/queries?q=req_id%3Dff3a1b and https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abc123
maria (oncall): tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre for a full RCA. Hypotheses to track in postmortem: 1) resource exhaustion on model-backend-1, 2) retry amplification at gateway, 3) a bad model variant/quantization increased memory.
irina: will continue to monitor during handoff. I'm taking on-call at 13:30Z and will own post-incident data collection.
ops-bot: Incident state updated -> mitigated (partial).
deploy-bot: Config canary -> promoted to gateway cluster by sam (rev: 84f5a2 -> 84f5a3)
maria (oncall): handoff: handing to @irina at 13:30Z. Leaving notes above. Great coordination, team. :pray:
irina: acknowledged. I'll open the RCA doc and start filling timeline + attach heap dumps and GC analysis.
pagerduty-bot: Incident severity updated: elevated -> resolved? (awaiting postmortem).
